answer: Interleaved Cadence Attestation. Each identity must emit signing traffic whose inter-arrival gaps form a cipher of its own past timing: the agent periodically proves it can predict and vary its own schedule. Attackers must sustain distinct human-plausible timing per identity, costing weeks of parallel scheduling per fake agent.
